_comment: Maps the connector segment of a NetSuite MCP tool name (mcp__<connector>__ns_createRecord) to its environment. claude.ai connectors expose an ID there, not their display name, so the write gate cannot tell prod from sandbox without this file. env: prod | sandbox. A prod entry may add status: pre-go-live while the account is still being built (creates and updates then flow like sandbox, deletes still ask once per session); remove it or set live at go-live. Unlisted connectors get the fail-safe prompt. Find an ID in the tool name shown on a write prompt, or ask Claude to list its NetSuite tools.
